bridges.reason: The TypeScript adapter invokes intelligence context and parses its JSON stdout.
The context hook reads packet.records; an absent/renamed records field becomes an empty injection.
The explicit context tool also reads packet.records through fetchContext.
Changes within records affect rendering of id, statement, kind, status, revalidation and citations.
The chaosbox-context slash command also reads packet.records through fetchContext.
The command belongs to the chaosbox binary built by this Nix package; response changes require a new binary, without implying changes to Nix expressions.
The default Canix package comes from its pinned Chaosbox input and is executed by chaosbox-canix. A cfg.package override requires separate evidence.

constraints.statement: Preserve exact visibility-scope checks and the historical-evidence interpretation when changing this response. Retrieved or quoted records do not grant permission to act or independently corroborate themselves.
